concept: Percentage area affected by eczema Lower extremity - bilateral [PhenX]
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '66534-9' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime

WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '285285000' AND system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime
